name: Symfony YAML

dependencies.symfony/deprecation-contracts: ^2.5|^3; bundled function.php and LICENSE from the pinned 3.7.1 revision
dependencies.symfony/polyfill-ctype: ^1.8; ctype functions must be provided by the native extension or a bootstrapped compatibility polyfill

included_files: Core runtime classes and LICENSE, including ParserState.php; Symfony Console command, resources and tests are not used or bundled
purpose: Parse OpenAPI YAML locally on PHP 8.1+ with object and custom-tag construction disabled; no server Composer installation is required
